title: Shinjuku Golden Gai pekee ndipo panapohisiwa kama Japani ya miaka 30 au 40 iliyopita
label: Golden Gai

text.🗼 MY SUMMER TRIP TO TOKYO: 🗼 SAFARI YANGU YA KIANGAZI KWENDA TOKYO
text.Personally, there was a place where I fe: Binafsi, nilipata sehemu moja ambayo mazingira yake yalihisi tofauti kabisa na kwingineko.
text.That is a place called Golden Gai in Shi: Hiyo ni Golden Gai huko Shinjuku.
text.Only in Golden Gai, the streets are very: Ni Golden Gai pekee yenye vichochoro vyembamba sana.
text.It feels like Japan from 30 or 40 years: Inahisi kama Japani ya miaka 30 au 40 iliyopita.
text.Even as a Japanese person, I did not kno: Hata mimi nikiwa Mjapani sikujua ni sehemu ya aina gani, kwa hiyo niliuliza AI.
text.In Golden Gai, it seems many bars open a: Inaonekana baa nyingi hufunguliwa usiku huko Golden Gai.
Inaonekana kuna sehemu nyingi za kunywa.
text.But it seems some of them are members-on: Lakini baadhi yao zinaonekana kuwa baa za wanachama pekee.
text.Not all of them are shops that normal cu: Si kila sehemu ni baa ambayo mteja wa kawaida anaweza kuingia tu na kusema, “Leo nataka kunywa, twende.”
text.In World War II, much of Tokyo once burn: Wakati wa Vita vya Pili vya Dunia, Tokyo iliwahi kuungua na kuwa magofu.
text.Then, many markets called \"black market: Baadaye, masoko mengi yaliyoitwa “masoko ya magendo” yalitokea.
text.It seems the area around Shinjuku Golden: Inaonekana moja ya masoko hayo ilikua katika eneo la Shinjuku Golden Gai.
text.Traces of that still remain, so the stre: Mabaki ya wakati huo bado yapo: vichochoro ni vyembamba sana na maduka yamebanana pamoja.
text.I wondered if it is OK to walk here at n: Nilijiuliza kama ni sawa kutembea hapa usiku.
text.Maybe people from Tokyo can walk through: Huenda wakazi wa Tokyo wanaweza kupita hapa bila shida.
text.But it feels like a place where you coul: Lakini panaonekana kuwa sehemu ambayo ni rahisi kupotea.
text.Shinjuku Golden Gai was very mysterious,: Shinjuku Golden Gai palikuwa pa ajabu sana, na kutembea huku na huko kulivutia.
text.It was daytime, so it was totally safe a: Hata hivyo, ilikuwa mchana, kwa hiyo palikuwa salama kabisa na hapakuwa na tatizo.
text.When you get tired in Tokyo, go to Therm: Ukichoka Tokyo, nenda Thermae-yu huko Shinjuku
